title: Verification Console
description: Final verification log comparing the merged Minecraft world against placements.jsonl, applying a narrow patch, removing tagged temporary blocks, and packaging replay artifacts.

messages.text: Loaded merged_state.json, placements.jsonl, west/east diffs, and tmp tag ledger from workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001. Starting verification.
messages.systemLog: verify INFO open world=world/merged_state.json blueprint=blueprint/placements.jsonl diffs=2 tmp_tags=2

messages.text: Coverage check is clean except for three entrance-detail rows. Silhouette and roof symmetry are within tolerance after the west row patch.
messages.systemLog: verify INFO coverage placed=9271 expected=9274 missing=0 material_mismatch=3 symmetry_delta=0.018

messages.text: Issuing a small whitelist patch: move two lanterns one block inward and swap one lower entry lip block to dark prismarine. Roof and foundation stay locked.
messages.systemLog: verify INFO patch write audit/patch_entry_details.json ops=3 lock=roof,foundation rollback=world/merged_state.pre_patch.json

messages.text: Applying the entrance patch exactly as listed. Diff monitor shows only the three approved coordinates changed.
messages.systemLog: builder-06 stdout apply_patch audit/patch_entry_details.json changed=3 rejected=0 protected_hits=0

messages.text: Removing temporary blocks by tag ID: tmp/scaffold/west-01 and tmp/path/north-03. No visual sweep or manual deletion.
Final audit passed. The world diff matches the blueprint after the approved patch, and no temporary tags remain in the exported schematic.
messages.systemLog: verify INFO pass final_blocks=9274 checksum=0f33d0a9... report=audit/report.json final=final/final_world.schem

messages.text: Packaging final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, logs/*.log, and the original input metadata for the run console.
messages.systemLog: package INFO tar --zstd -cf final/craft_tiantan_build_001.tar.zst final_world.schem audit/report.json logs/*.log replay.jsonl run.json
